documents.title: Main Entry Point
documents.description: Launches API + UI + Scout scheduler + synthesis keep-warm. CLI: --api-only / --ui-only / --scout / --init-db.

documents.title: FastAPI App
documents.description: 60+ REST endpoints on port 8010: /synthesize(/stream), /judge, /providers*, /config/*, /sessions, /history, /scout/*, /batch/*, /schedule/*, /personas*, /bench/*, /rag/*, /curate/*, /upload/extract. CORS from qi_registry.

documents.title: Core Dispatcher
documents.description: Parallel asyncio dispatch to all providers + chain_dispatch + dispatch_stream. Lazy provider load; returns DispatchResult with successful/failed.

documents.title: Core Synthesizer
documents.description: Merges responses via the configured synthesis provider (gemma4:26b primary, chatgpt fallback). Preserves tables/code; concatenates as last resort.

documents.title: Inference Modes
documents.description: Fast/Balanced/Thinking/Deep capability registry + per-mode timeout multipliers. Single source of truth for /providers/capabilities.

documents.title: Scheduler & Batch Runner
documents.description: APScheduler wrapper for Scout + scheduled jobs; batch prompt execution with per-prompt logs.

documents.title: Scorer (DeepEval bridge)
documents.description: NexusJudge wraps any provider as a DeepEval LLM; runs concurrent G-Eval Clarity/Accuracy/Depth with per-metric timeout + simple-mode fallback.

documents.title: Provider Base
documents.description: NexusProvider ABC + ProviderResponse dataclass. Adding a provider = one file here + an entry in providers.json.

documents.title: Scout Runner
documents.description: run_scout_cycle(topic_id): fetch -> dedup -> store -> digest. Idempotent topic_id migration at import.

documents.title: Scout Fetcher / Dedup / Digest
documents.description: Topic-aware RSS/Reddit/HN fetch; rapidfuzz dedup at 85%; markdown + .docx digest generation.

documents.title: Bench Runner
documents.description: run_suite() runs each case x provider, scores, persists bench_provider_runs + bench_results; recommend() ranks providers by mean score; seed_starter_suite().

documents.title: Shared DB + Schema
documents.description: init_db() + idempotent migrations; SQLite WAL, FK on; schema_version v4 (bench tables added 2026-06-13).

documents.title: Shared RAG
documents.description: NexusRAG over ChromaDB (collection nexus_knowledge). Background init with 300s deadline; ingests knowledge/nexus_curated.jsonl + curated exports.

documents.title: Shared Config + Logging
documents.description: Dotted-path get() over nexus.json with hot reload; per-subsystem rotating log handlers (scorer.log, dispatcher.log).

documents.title: Runtime Config
documents.description: Ports, core (synthesis provider/model, keep-warm), scout (interval, dedup threshold), scorer (mode=deepeval, judge=groq), logging subsystems.

documents.title: Providers
documents.description: Live source of truth for all 18 registered providers — adapter, enabled flag, model, env_key, role, timeout, notes.

documents.title: Personas / User Personas
documents.description: 26 built-in expert personas (locked, real-expert-inspired) + user-created personas.

documents.title: Scout Topics / Sources
documents.description: Topic registry (ai_news default + TubeScout YouTube topics) with per-topic RSS/Reddit/HN sources.
